policy: MajorMUD is a 16-bit legacy target, but widths are proven field-by-field; no global short coercion and no guessed AI order.

facts.detail: Nightmare Redux MonsterRecType explicitly mixes VB6 Integer (16-bit), Byte (8-bit), and Long (32-bit) fields; runtime validates decoded Classic NPC definitions against those widths.

Native Follow is a signed 16-bit record field and MMUD Explorer export mapping names it Follow%; all 1100 retained Classic NPC values are 0..100. Exact decision timing for the roll remains unresolved.
Attack selection percent is a native byte. Retained executable rows include values >100, so it must not be clamped to 100; Pass 10 inclusive d100 threshold semantics preserve saturation.
Ability 146 is MonsGuards and carries guarded monster legacy ids. Classic runtime consumes only this relationship for NPC guard admission; exact native timing/propagation/priority remains unresolved.
Message 8480 is a physical dodge/miss template, not an assist broadcast.
Four Thrag rows are bound; five Nahr npc.1006 rows still lack exact caller-owned miss verb/weapon arguments.
Flee/base perception/aggro/target switching/patrol/tracking and exact decision priority/cadence have not been recovered.
